answer: Problem: bots spin many keys and replay one story to farm epoch rewards. Mechanism: at the summit of each round we require a nebula-fresh sample that names a lived garden check—signed window, peer word-match, and non-clone cadence—before credits settle. Cost: each identity must mint new prose and stamp work, not paste a template. Verification: peers refuse attestations on near-duplicates and empty padding. Failure: shared windows or cloned summit/nebula/garden phrasing stall stamps and cut emission.
